rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP and viewed orders, but then submitted a return without confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the user requested a refund to credit card if possible; the agent processed a refund to a gift card without checking or explaining why a credit card refund wasn’t possible and without obtaining consent to switch to gift card. The agent also did not verify which of the two tablets was the more expensive before proceeding. While the final message matches the tool action, the policy violations (unconfirmed write and disregarding the user’s refund preference) mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
